Across all observed sessions in Field Study 1, his classroom practice exemplified the integration of structured DepEd lesson planning, Socratic questioning, and tactile instructional scaffolding.

schoolSite.campusOverview: The cooperating public secondary school features a multi-building academic campus organized around a central quadrangle, covered walkways, and dedicated departmental wings.
schoolSite.description: Observations were conducted in Mr. Herson N. Alamo's secondary English classroom. The learning space is arranged to support both whole-class direct modeling at the front board and rapid transitions into cooperative student pairs and small groups.
rulesAndRegulations: Arrive punctually in prescribed Field Study observer attire and display the official Bicol University identification card at all times.
Coordinate all classroom observation schedules, seating placements, and artifact documentation in advance with the Cooperating Resource Teacher.
Maintain non-intrusive observational discipline during instructional delivery; record field notes quietly without disrupting learner focus.
Uphold strict learner privacy and data protection: anonymize student names in analytical notes and blur or crop any identifiable student faces in photographic documentation.
Complete and sign the Daily Time Record (DTR) accurately after each observation session for verification by the Resource Teacher.
